newsitem.title: JAPAN: At least nine firms to buy Q1 Yemen crude - traders.
newsitem.headline: At least nine firms to buy Q1 Yemen crude - traders.

text.p: At least nine oil companies have agreed to buy Masila crude oil from Yemen for January to March loading at dated Brent minus 97 cents, oil industry sources said on Thursday.
The price during the fourth quarter of this year was dated Brent minus 55 cents.
A few traditional Masila buyers decided not to purchase the crude in the first quarter, because they consider the prices too high, traders said.
Some traders said they had not made a final reply to Yemen. Tender bids are valid until December 5.
Yemen earlier this week said it had received bids from 20 Arab and international companies to buy crude oil for the first quarter in response to a sales tender issued last month.
Yemen exports about 100,000 bpd of Masila and 30,000 bpd of Marib Light to Japanese, South Korean and European buyers.
